limits.heat: Outdoor air reanalysis, about 11 km; threshold counts are not indoor conditions, collection damage or heat-health diagnoses.
limits.humidity: Paired hourly outdoor air/dewpoint screening in 2024, about 11 km; warm/humid hours are not indoor dampness or a mould prediction.
limits.fire: 500 m MODIS burned-area observations within 2 km; quality/support-qualified history, not ignition cause, smoke exposure, building burning or future fire probability.
limits.rain: CHIRPS v2 final, 0.05 degree; annual rainfall departure from 1991–2020 is a rainfall-deficit indicator, not SPI/SPEI, soil moisture or actual institutional water supply.
limits.future: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 native 0.25-degree regional climate-grid context at source coordinates. Three illustrative models, not the full ensemble or a probability interval. Compare within model/product, never subtract reanalysis from future models.
